name: devops
description: Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions and Jenkins: templates, permissions, secrets, triggers and deploys, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

interface.longDescription: Rules with stable IDs for CI/CD pipelines in Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions and Jenkins: templates and reusable workflows, least-privilege tokens, secrets, release triggers, environments and approvals, plus scripts for the checks that have one right answer.
